question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given idiom.

A piece of __biscuit__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"biscuit"** typically refers to a small baked unleavened cake, often crisp, flat, and sweet. (बिस्किट)

 
 
• **Example:** I enjoyed a cup of tea with a piece of** biscuit.**
 
 
 
• **"Cake"** refers to a sweet baked food made from a mixture of flour, sugar, and other ingredients, usually including butter or oil and eggs. (केक)
 
 
• **Example:** The birthday party featured a delicious chocolate **cake.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct substitution for **"A piece of biscuit"** in the idiom is **"A piece of cake".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **cake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Pastry** (पेस्ट्री): A dough of flour, water, and shortening that may be sweetened or unsweetened.

 
 
• **Example:** She bought a delicious pastry from the bakery.
 
 
 
• **Tart** (टार्ट): An open pastry case containing a filling.
 
 
• **Example:** The lemon tart was both sweet and tangy.
 
 
 
• **Toast** (टोस्ट): Sliced bread browned on both sides by exposure to radiant heat.
 
 
• **Example:** I had buttered toast for breakfast.
